title: Weekly planning session every Wednesday before the usage reset
note: OPERATOR 2026-10-13 ~07:00Z verbatim: 'I also want to make sure that we start doing weekly planning - this should be on Wednesday so that we have to time to set the plan before the reset, then hit the ground running afterwards. What we want from these sessions: 1. Review of the week's work and system performance - what worked well and what didn't, where do we need to focus our efforts on improving, etc. 2. Roadmap review and update based on what we learned/built the previous week 3. Scheduling all the regular sessions that need to be handled (research reviews, performance/health reviews, audits, etc) 4. Based on roadmap review, we start building the workplan - what are our priorities, what tasks need to be added to the work que, how many resources are allotted to each priority, and at least a preliminary schedule for running through the work (this will obviously need to change be updated throughout the week at the daily review sessions, but i want us start the week after the reset with a plan that could carry us through to the end so we don't end up in situations where we don't have any work going on)'. [2026-10-13T07:00Z manager] Routine created: trig_01Pm8AMPiigZX9ndobeyT6dE, cron '44 9 * * 3' (Wednesdays 09:44Z; reset is Wed ~17:59Z), fires into the manager session; deliverable = published plan Artifact + self-land PR + operator popups. It supersedes the Monday ROADMAP-PASS-<week> roadmap pass. First run 2026-10-14; that run also dispatches a small Sonnet lane to codify the section in .claude/skills/manager/SKILL.md (not on the manager surface). [2026-10-13T07:02Z manager] OPERATOR clarification verbatim: 'just for clarity - this session isn't just making a report, it's a dialogue between both of us to work together on building our understanding, and then based on that, the work priorities'. Priorities are never finalized without the operator.
